name: Chuugokugo de Moeyou! 2 -Native Shoujo no Anime Koe-
original_name: 中国語で萌えよう!2ーネイティブ少女のアニメ声ー
source:
One day, Touichi's class welcomes a Chinese girl.
He soon falls in love with her and tries to talk to her in Chinese.
His purpose is to confess his love to her in Chinese.

Voiced by a Chinese voice actress.
Every Chinese script has its Japanese translation.

[Edited From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE239813.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
有一天，东一的班级迎来了一位中国女孩。
他很快就爱上了她，并尝试用中文与她交谈。
他的目的是用中文向她表白。

由中国配音演员配音。
每个中文文字都有其日文翻译。

[编辑自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE239813.html]DLSite English[/url]]
